topic: 类脑模型近一年的发展

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm-web-calibration dynamic expansion (medium): Topic 'brain-inspired models' is outside the static embodied-AI taxonomy. Calibration via web search (2026-08) surfaced: SpikingBrain/瞬悉 1.0 (CAS-IA + MetaX, 2025-09), SpikingBrain 2.0 (BICLab, 2026-04), SpikeLLM, NSLLM (algorithm-hardware co-design), Rhythm-SNN (Nat Commun 2025), NeuroVLA (brain-inspired embodied VLA), PKU memristor neural-dynamics chip (2026-07), organoid intelligence/Brainoware, Hebbian meta-learning for continual learning (AAAI-2026).

dynamic_suggestions.label: direct-brain-inspired-models
dynamic_suggestions.why: Direct surface for brain-inspired model papers.

dynamic_suggestions.label: direct-spiking-large-models
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"spiking" AND (all:"large language model" OR all:LLM OR all:transformer)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Spiking LLM/transformer is the fastest-moving subfamily of the past year (SpikeLLM, SpikingBrain, SpikeGPT lineage).

dynamic_suggestions.label: direct-neuromorphic-computing
dynamic_suggestions.why: Core neuromorphic computing surface covering models and co-designed hardware.

dynamic_suggestions.label: direct-brain-foundation-model
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"brain" AND (all:"foundation model" OR all:"large brain model" OR all:"whole-brain")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Brain-data foundation models (BrainLM lineage) and whole-brain modeling are a distinct direct surface.

dynamic_suggestions.label: mechanism-snn-training
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"spiking neural network" AND (all:training OR all:"surrogate gradient" OR all:"conversion")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Mechanism surface: how SNNs are trained (surrogate gradients, ANN-to-SNN conversion) governs model quality.

dynamic_suggestions.label: mechanism-bio-plausible-learning
dynamic_suggestions.why: STDP and bio-plausible learning rules are the algorithmic core of brain-inspired models.

dynamic_suggestions.label: mechanism-neural-dynamics
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"neural dynamics" OR all:"oscillations" OR all:"predictive coding" OR all:"attractor"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Brain-dynamics-inspired mechanisms (oscillation, predictive coding, attractors) emerged as a 2025-2026 differentiator (Rhythm-SNN).

dynamic_suggestions.label: mechanism-cognitive-architecture
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"cognitive architecture" OR all:"cortical" OR all:"hippocampal" OR all:"hippocampus"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cortical/hippocampal architecture transfer (memory, continual learning, replay) is a mechanism surface.

dynamic_suggestions.label: limit-snn-scaling
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"spiking neural network" AND (all:scalability OR all:limitation OR all:challenge OR all:bottleneck)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Negative/limit evidence: accuracy gap vs ANN, training cost, scaling limits.

dynamic_suggestions.label: evaluation-snn-benchmark
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"spiking" AND (all:benchmark OR all:"energy efficiency" OR all:accuracy OR all:evaluation)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Evaluation surface: how brain-inspired models are measured (accuracy, energy, latency).

dynamic_suggestions.label: deployment-neuromorphic-hardware
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"neuromorphic" AND (all:chip OR all:hardware OR all:memristor OR all:processor)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Deployment surface: Loihi-class chips, memristor/PCM systems, algorithm-hardware co-design.

dynamic_suggestions.label: deployment-event-robotics
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"event camera" OR (all:"spiking" AND (all:robot OR all:embodied OR all:"vision-language-action"))
dynamic_suggestions.why: Event-driven sensing + spiking embodied models (NeuroVLA lineage) is the deployment-facing frontier.

dynamic_suggestions.label: adjacent-organoid-intelligence
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"organoid intelligence" OR all:"organoid" AND all:"computing" OR all:"Brainoware"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Adjacent surface: biological-computing hybrids using living neuronal cultures.

dynamic_suggestions.label: adjacent-active-inference
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"active inference" OR all:"free energy principle" OR all:"free-energy"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Adjacent theory family: brain-theoretic learning frameworks.

dynamic_suggestions.label: adjacent-bci-neural-data
dynamic_suggestions.why: Adjacent surface: neural-data models at the BCI boundary.

dynamic_suggestions.why: Check for models not well indexed by arXiv API keyword search.
